title: Approval of the Award of a twelve (12)-year Concession Agreement to Host International Inc.: With a three (3)-year extension option, covering development, management and operation of food and beverage
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a twelve (12)-year Concession Agreement to Host International Inc.: With a three (3)-year extension option, covering development, management and operation of food and beverage concessions in Terminal 4 at Los Angeles International Airport, for estimated minimum revenue of $30,000,000 over the potential fifteen (15)-year term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Awards Host International Inc. a 12-year food and beverage concession for Terminal 4 at LAX, with a three-year extension option and estimated minimum revenue of $30 million over the potential 15-year term.

locations.text: Terminal 4, Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
